verdict.rationale: EDD's published file-and-pay page says payroll tax payments can be made with "No enrollment is necessary," which is a documented keyless entry path for one online flow. The other core flows (registration, filing returns, account management) sit behind e-Services enrollment with email verification and multi-factor setup. missing for 10: a documented no-account path for registration and filing, details of the file-number or account-number entry fields for the no-enrollment payment, and independent or hands-on confirmation (the portal returned 403).

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path

citations.quote: Make a payroll tax payment. No enrollment is necessary to use this service.
